description: Record or remove a spatial relationship between two entities. Actions: add, remove. Relations: on, inside, next_to, above, below, near, contains, occluded_by, connected_to, facing, holding, part_of, custom. This mutates the relation graph only, not entity poses. Returns {ok, relation}. Use set_relation instead of update_entity when establishing topological links (on, inside, contains) rather than setting entity coordinates.

bidirectional.description: If true, automatically sets inverse relationship on target

offset.description: Relative offset vector from source to target

name: set_relation
